prompts.crest: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved Leonel effects concept. Extract/reconstruct ONLY the luminous rear heraldic crest with its lion head at top, as an isolated game VFX sprite on genuine transparent alpha. Match the exact approved motif: open shield silhouette, ornate flowing silver-white filigree, two large narrow diamond stars flanking the sides, slender vertical lower branches, crowned frontal lion head centered on top. Preserve the proportions and sparse open interior. Remove the character, sword, ground seal, floor and environment entirely. Complete only linework hidden by the character, keeping the center mostly empty so the character will remain readable in front. Pure white/platinum luminous core with very restrained warm-white edges and controlled soft bloom. Front-facing, symmetrical upright crest, centered, full complete object with at least 6% transparent padding on every side. No black/colored background, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no text, no UI, no border. One crest sprite, not a sheet.
prompts.ground: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved Leonel concept. Extract ONLY the thin silver-white underfoot luminous seal as a separate transparent game VFX sprite. Preserve the approved shallow ellipse and elegant fine heraldic tracery with centered pointed diamond-star foreground ornament, narrow double arc rings and tiny restrained low sparks. Remove both boots, character, sword, rear crest, stone floor and all environment. Complete the small linework hidden under the boots. The empty interior and outside must be transparent alpha; no solid disk, no fog, no raised platform, no vertical pillar. Keep the same ground perspective as the input, approximately 4.5:1 wide ellipse for the main ring, with the foreground small diamond ornament. White/platinum luminous core and controlled bloom. Center the full seal in a wide rectangular image with transparent padding all around. No text, labels, UI, baked checkerboard or background.
prompts.sword:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 12-frame looping white sword-aura game VFX spritesheet on real transparent alpha. Reference image 1 is the approved Leonel concept; use ONLY its pure-white aura around the sword as the visual style. Do NOT include any character, weapon, heraldic crest, ground or background.
Draw exactly 12 consecutive animation cells in a clean 4 columns by 3 rows regular grid, each cell identical dimensions and no labels or grid lines. In every cell an identical registered long horizontal pure-white energy sheath runs from left (base at 12% of cell width) toward right (point at 88% cell width), axis centered at 50% cell height. Its core is very slender and mostly open/transparent so a real blade can be shown on top. Soft silver-white bloom and several thin curling WHITE wisps wrap and flow along the axis, subtle sparks drift outward and fade. The wisps must genuinely evolve smoothly from one frame to the next; maintain same fixed length, registration and width envelope. Last frame connects seamlessly back to first. At least 10% transparent safe margins in each cell; nothing crosses between cells. White only with faint silver, no colored flames, no black/white opaque rectangle, no drawn sword or handle, no text/watermark. High-quality polished 2D anime RPG additive energy art.
